section_path: Payment Integrity Review — Outpatient Infusion Site of Care
chunks.text:
Payment integrity review of claims adjudicated under medical policy MP-1250 (Outpatient
Infusion Site of Care).

Observation: a proportion of paid claims for procedure code 96365 lack documentation
evidencing documented failure of at least six weeks of conservative management on
retrospective sampling.

Reported measure: the proportion of denials citing insufficient documentation.

Recommended action: tighten the edit configuration in the utilisation management workflow
and issue provider education. Owner: Clinical Reviewer; oversight by the Configuration
Analyst.
